title: Heisenberg's heavy-water program and deuterium-reactor UFO propulsion

tellings.quote: a lot of the rumors around, you know, UFOs and how they fly involve a dutyium reactor, you know, in the middle, like a heavy water engine.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, connects the 1940s German nuclear programme of physicist Werner Heisenberg, which relied on heavy water, a form of water made with a heavier kind of hydrogen called deuterium, to rumours about how UFOs fly. Michels says many of those rumours describe a deuterium reactor, a heavy water engine, sitting in the middle of the craft, which would hint that the secret of their flight has roots in wartime physics.
